'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mark VanDriel LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark VanDriel]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)|VB6-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Maven Drell
* '''Deck name:''' Turn over Son, I'm the big Spoon in this ...
* '''Username:''' MAVanDriel
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
